function.description: Preview a token swap on Uniswap WITHOUT executing. Returns the expected output amount, price impact, the route Uniswap would take, and the fees. EVM ONLY (chain must NOT be "solana") and only on the EVM chains with a verified Vex Uniswap deployment. Tokens must be a CONTRACT ADDRESS or native ETH/native. For an EVM token, call TokenFind with exactly one target chain and continue only when mutationReady is true. Ambiguous, provider-capped, or metadata-unreadable results are not executable identities. If the swap pair is already known, prefer its exact base or quote token address and use TokenFind to validate that address on the target chain. TokenFind reads symbol and decimals from the contract, never provider list metadata. `amountIn` is the HUMAN decimal of tokenIn. Call this BEFORE SwapExecuteUniswap: an execute is authorized only by a fresh matching quote on the SAME venue, so a KyberSwap quote cannot authorize a Uniswap execute. A ROUTE BEING AVAILABLE DOES NOT MEAN THE WALLET CAN PAY FOR IT: this quote also reads the selected wallet and returns an `eligibility` block with its own `eligibilityNote`, and only `eligibility.executable` true authorizes an execute. The three balance outcomes are DISTINCT facts with distinct remedies. `insufficient_balance` means the wallet holds less of the input token than the trade needs, and names required, current and missing. `gas_reserve_insufficient` means the input side is covered but the wallet cannot cover the TOTAL NATIVE DEBIT: every transaction this swap would broadcast - the allowance legs where they are needed, the swap, and the SEPARATE Vex fee transfer - including the L1 data fee where the chain charges one, plus a measured reserve for one more transaction afterwards, so an ERC-20 swap needs native too. `balance_unavailable` means a balance could not be READ, which is never the same statement as the wallet being short and always fails closed: retry rather than resize. `balanceChecked` false means no wallet was read and this answer states nothing about funds. An ineligible quote still returns its full route and still records itself, so a later execute cannot fall back on an older funded quote. Every balance figure here is a QUOTE-TIME OBSERVATION at the pending block, advisory and ageing: the authoritative read happens again immediately before each signature, so an execute can still refuse for balance after this call said executable. KyberSwap is the primary swap route - reach for this one when KyberSwap cannot serve the pair or its quote failed for a routing reason.
function.name: SwapQuoteUniswap

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn to swap, in HUMAN decimal units (e.g. "1.5"). Not wei.

chain.description: EVM chain to swap on (ethereum, base, arbitrum, robinhood, …) — Uniswap ONLY, no venue routing. Solana is NOT supported by this tool.

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%); default 100 = 1%, which fits deep, liquid pairs. It is the ONLY price protection on the trade. Pass the SAME value to the quote and the execute, or omit it on both — a mismatch blocks the execute. On a thin or volatile pair (new listings, memecoins, small pools) 100 bps often fails. When it fails, the message says so and names this parameter: re-quote with a higher slippageBps and pass the same value to the execute. Do not read a slippage failure as "this pair is untradeable" and do not switch venue for it — another venue at 100 bps fails the same way. Vex caps it at 1000 (10%) and REJECTS anything above rather than clamping; every increase widens the worst-case price you accept, so raise it in steps.
